text:
You need a Full Stack Developer to build an MVP for an RPG storytelling website with ChatGPT integration, covering both the client side and server side from the ground up.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’ve built a clipboard sync browser extension for Clipboardly using TypeScript, the Chrome Extensions API, Express, and MongoDB, which reached 9k weekly active users and a 4.7 store rating. I also built a streaming chat widget for Quillstack with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Server-Sent Events, and the OpenAI API, delivering first token display in about 600 ms and handling 30k chats a month.

I’m comfortable working in agile, writing clean scalable code, and shaping an interactive MVP quickly. For your RPG game, will the ChatGPT integration need streaming responses from the first version?
